Author, In This Life I’m The Protagonist

Read manhwa Author, In This Life I’m The Protagonist / Author, I’m the Heroine Of This Life / 弃坑作者被迫当女主 / 작가님, 이번 생은 여주인공입니다
“The writer seems to have a hard time writing by hand, so I think it would be better to try writing with your feet this time.”
I was drawn into the hand of a God who calls Himself my fan, and possessed it as a supporting role in a novel that I had been working on all year round.
“Make sure to complete it with the determination to die, or the determination to survive.”
While I was working hard at God’s threat of death if I couldn’t finish the novel, the female protagonist died right in front of me?!
He grabbed the crotch of the indignant God and hung it.
“… If I can even play a pinch hitter, I can.”
“Dae-Tara… . Do you think the writer wants to become a female protagonist?”
“Why, where can’t you? I am a writer, a writer!”
She received the Buffalo buff and succeeded in joining the adventures of the man.
“Young-ae’s help, I will never forget. One day I will surely repay this favor.”
There is no reason to fall in love with the man I made.
have.
He’s tough and tough, but he’s so handsome and handsome.
What about those red auricles?
Past life is a writer, current life is a female protagonist.
Adventure, romance, and desperate struggles unfolding by the writer who rolls over as a female lead in a year-round work?!
